name: Metrics
description: This folder contains metric based dashboards for Cassandra App

children.name: Cassandra - Compactions
children.description: The Cassandra - Compactions dashboard provides a good insight into the compaction strategy used as each strategy has a unique operational footprint. Specific Cassandra operations like repairs, high volume data writes, add/remove/replace nodes etc. increase the compaction activity.
children.title: Cassandra - Compactions

queries.queryString: metric=cassandra_TableMetrics_PendingCompactions_Value name=pendingcompactions db_cluster={{db_cluster}} host={{host}} db_system=cassandra _sourceCategory = Labs/cassandra*  | sum by db_cluster,host,keyspace

metric=cassandra_TableMetrics_CompactionBytesWritten_Count db_cluster={{db_cluster}} host={{host}} db_system=cassandra _sourceCategory = Labs/cassandra*  | sum by db_cluster, host, keyspace | eval _value/1024/1024

children.name: Cassandra - Read Path
children.description: The Cassandra - Read Path dashboard aims to display critical information on anything that could impact a high-level client read in Cassandra.
children.title: Cassandra - Read Path

panels.title: Nb SSTables per Read  50th Percentile

queries.queryString: metric=cassandra_TableMetrics_SSTablesPerReadHistogram_50thPercentile db_cluster={{db_cluster}} host={{host}} db_system=cassandra _sourceCategory = Labs/cassandra*   | sum by db_cluster, host, keyspace | filter max>0

panels.description:
_SSTables are the immutable data files that Cassandra uses for persisting data on disk.

_ Histogram of the number of sstable data files accessed per single partition read. SSTables skipped due to Bloom Filters, min-max key or partition index lookup are not taken into acoount. 

_Metric Types: Histogram
